text_block_list.text:
It's finally starting... The first match of
the Triple
Crown tour, a once in a
lifetime race, is here.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Once I leave the waiting room, there will
be no
turning back. My only option will
be to stand at
the paddock...
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: And win.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I know. Well then, it's time to
shine.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Wooooo!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: There are so many people.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
I knew what the Hopeful Stakes would
be like,
but the Classics are in a league
of their own...
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: It feels quite different, doesn't it?
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text: ...Sky.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Those cheers sure were something, huh.
Everyone
was super loud when you came
out.
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text: But then again, you are this year's top contender. They're really rooting for you.
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text: Hmph, of course. It would be strange if they weren't supporting me.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Yowza. Spoken like a true star. Sigh... Is this the difference between you and me?
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text:
I sure got the short end of the stick. Why
do I
have to go against both you and
Spe at the
Satsuki Sho in my debut
year?
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text: Oh? Спешл Уик is here too?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
That's right! It's like all the big names
are here. I'm
so overwhelmed!
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text: Sigh... Maybe this is too big for a little ol' nobody like me. Sniffle.
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text:
How could a nobody make it all the way
to such a
grand stage as this?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Not to mention how you've stayed fit
and
well-adjusted the entire time.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Nyahaha! Oh, King. You exaggerate.
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text:
Hmph. It's just the truth. But with all that
said...
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
No matter what factors come into play, I,
King
Halo, am taking first.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: I need good results... and recognition.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало
